The final token `{"code` opens a new JSON object key, directly mirroring the previous `{"code` pattern, so the next token must complete this key (e.g., `":` or a different field name like `"code"` or `"answer"`).
"code" field name repetition signals continuation of the same structural template.
"code" in the second example replaces "name" + "code" from the first, so the next tokens likely show a code snippet or question value.
